2:301.en: 「If you're going to stand in our way!」
alternatives: If you mean to stand in our way...!
The world will know A21's name!
Just do what I was taught...!

2:658.en: 「I'll cut you to pieces with this!」
alternatives: I'll slice you apart with this!

2:712.en: 「No time to waste. I'll end this now!」
alternatives: No time. I'll finish this at once!

2:782.en: 「$$セイナ$$ said to watch out for you!」

2:821.en: 「So the famous $$ミスリル$$ showed up!」
alternatives: So the famed Mithril is here!
We'll take out their sniper first!
First rule: take out the commander!

2:961.en: 「So the heroes of justice are here!」
alternatives: The heroes of justice are here...!
A useless hulk is nothing to fear!

2:1031.en: 「Beat a Gundam and we'll be famous!」
alternatives: Down a Gundam, earn our fame!
I'll burn down your company too!
You dared interfere with our plan!
So I'm up against Kallen Kozuki!

2:1282.en: 「So I have to fight Captain Kozuki!」
alternatives: To think I'd fight Captain Kozuki!

2:1317.en: 「I know $$紅蓮$$'s terror all too well!」
alternatives: I know how fearsome Guren can be!
So the witch C.C. has come!

2:1467.en: 「That mobility makes it a tough foe!」

2:1506.en: 「They hit us. Now we hit back!」
alternatives: They hit us, so we'll hit back!
You think I'll let you escape?!

2:1641.en: 「I won't let you interfere with us!」
alternatives: We won't let you stop us!

2:1759.en: 「$$セイナ$$, leave the rest to me!」

2:1788.en: 「I won't let you hurt my comrades!」
alternatives: I won't let them hurt my comrades!
We'll pick them off one by one!
Got it, I'll go on ahead!

2:2068.en: 「I have no choice but to hold out...!」

alternatives: We can't spare a single second...!

2:2230.en: 「I can't believe I lost them now...!」
alternatives: Of all times to lose the enemy...!
We came prepared to go all the way!
After all the training we've done!

2:2368.en: 「Don't think I'll stay in one place!」

alternatives: I expected an attack like that!
I came prepared for this much!

2:2573.en: 「This is nothing! No problem at all!」

2:2629.en: 「No time to worry about a scratch!」
alternatives: No time to fret over minor damage!
All that arrogance, and that's it!?
So you're all looks, no substance!
You're only a cut above small fry!
Keep moving and avoid direct hits!
Damn it! Did that hit me?!
Reality isn't so kind after all...!
This is easy after that training!
Damn! The leg section took a hit!
Output's stable! I can still fight!
Till the plan is done,\nhold on!

alternatives: Nowhere to return!\nI must press on!

alternatives: Move, you junk heap! Keep fighting!

Till I burn it all,\nI cannot fall!

Damn it! A21's spirit is immortal!
